description: This file defines the DefaultHttpClientFacade class that implements HTTP client functionalities using Akka HTTP. It manages HTTP request creation, singleton instance retrieval, and configuration setup, particularly for proxy settings.

classes.name: DefaultHttpClientFacade
classes.description: A singleton class that provides HTTP client functionalities with support for proxy configuration, encapsulating Akka HTTP request mechanisms.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DefaultHttpClientFacade, creating it if it doesn't exist, and configuring proxy settings if enabled.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultHttpClientFacade with appropriate connection pool settings, including proxy configuration if enabled.

methods.name: createSingleHttpRequest
methods.description: Executes a single HTTP request asynchronously using Akka HTTP.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns the ActorSystem associated with this HTTP client facade.
